_meta.note: Quest catalog for xkx2001 (侠客行). Extracted/verified from live mudlib source under run/. Each quest lists giver, prerequisites (gated in source), the action sequence, fill/turn-in checks, rewards, failure modes, and the room route as area-relative hops. Where a step uses a RANDOM exit (set at create()) it is flagged 'random_exit' — those hops are NOT in the static map graph (see warnings.json) and the agent must probe at runtime.

quests.name: 少林挑水任务 (water-carrying)
quests.purpose: Low-level potential + combat_exp grind for shaolin disciples; the canonical 'first job' to teach the loop how to fill/carry/turn-in and walk a random-exit return path.

prerequisites.family: 弟子必须是 少林派 (query('family/family_name')=='少林派')
prerequisites.not_already_assigned: query('job_asked')/job 未在身 (job_asked flag must be unset)
prerequisites.cooldown: ts_pending 冷却未过则拒绝 (turn-in sets ts_pending)

verbs_on_tong.tiao: do_tiao — 挑起水桶 (carry on shoulder)
verbs_on_tong.fang: do_fang — 放下水桶 (must put down before 舀; sets tong_pos)
verbs_on_tong.dao: do_dao — 把瓢里的水倒进桶, water_level += from piao; water_level==5 => set('full',1)

fill_mechanism.why: The 'yao' verb is an add_action do_yao hardcoded in riverbank.c init(); it fills the 瓢 (piao) only if player has shaolin job_asked. Drop rate 1/100 (room) or 1/10 (npc variant).
fill_mechanism.fill_loop: yao shui (repeat until piao full) -> dao (pour piao into tong) -> repeat until tong water_level==5 => tong becomes 'full'

back_hall_well_DEADEND.question: 后殿内水井 (well in /d/shaolin/houdian) 是不是更近的取水点？
back_hall_well_DEADEND.reason: houdian.c 仅 set('resource/water',1) 并在 long 描述里提到「佛心清水井」，但它 NO add_action('do_yao','yao')。'yao shui' 取水动作只在 riverbank.c / npc/riverbank.c 里硬编码。turn-in (tiaoshui2.h accept_object) 只检查桶的 query('full'），不检查取水地点；但 'full' 只能靠 dao 倒入由 yao 在河边灌满的 piao 得到。所以无论后殿水井多近，都无法在那里把桶灌满。河边取水 + 山路随机返回是强制路径。
back_hall_well_DEADEND.src: run/d/shaolin/houdian.c (no do_yao), run/d/shaolin/npc/tiaoshui2.h accept_object (only checks full)

checks: player has 'tiaoshui' condition (time budget not expired)
owner of tong matches turn-in player

route_skills.note: Implemented as gateway route-skills under pi_mud_gateway/skills/shaolin-water-carrying/. See that SKILL.md.
ordered: shaolin_chufang_prepare_water_tools  (get tong; fang; ready to carry)
shaolin_water_fill_bucket_at_riverbank  (yao shui xN -> dao -> until full)

random_exit_warning.detail: shanlu.c create() sets exits randomly: southdown->riverbank ALWAYS, plus ONE of {up|westup|northwest|northup}->shanlu1 chosen per-reset. valid_leave can slip/spill/break-bucket (~1/30)/fall. So the return leg is NOT a fixed graph path — agent must read exits each visit and pick the live one, and re-fill if the bucket spills.

failure_modes: tiaoshui condition expires (time budget 2000+random(600) ran out) -> turn-in rejected
bucket spills/breaks on shanlu (valid_leave ~1/30) -> water_level lost, must re-fill at riverbank
wrong fill location (e.g. tried 后殿水井) -> bucket never reaches 'full', turn-in impossible
not 少林派 family -> giver refuses

quests.name: 拜师学艺 (join sect + learn skills) — shaolin example
quests.purpose: The core advancement loop: join a sect, then repeatedly find the right master and 'learn <master> <skill>' (and 'study'/practice) to raise skills, gated by potential, the student's combat_exp, sect membership, and 武学常识 (literate).

join.effect: sets family/family_name to the sect; unlocks sect masters' teaching
join.note: Each sect has an entry master; for shaolin see masters.json sect=='shaolin' standing in /d/shaolin/.

learn_loop.find_master: scripts/find_master.py --skill <skill_id> [--sect shaolin] [--from <here>]  -> master name, room, route
learn_loop.verb: learn <master> <skill>   (反复 learn 直到提示需要更高 potential/常识)
learn_loop.raise: study / lian <skill>  to convert potential into skill level; dazuo to raise neili first if a force skill
gates: potential 足够 (learn 消耗潜能)
literate (武学常识) >= 该武功可学等级闸门 (see attributes.md §5)
must be sect family member for sect-restricted skills

data_sources.masters: data/masters.json (191 masters; 139 with fixed rooms). Fields: name, npc_id, sect, teaches[], combat_exp, room_id, room_short, area.
data_sources.note: npc_id starting /kungfu/class/ is a master MIXIN (no fixed room); the concrete /d/<area>/npc/ NPC that inherits it carries the room. find_master shows both; route only the ones with a room_id.
